blocks.text:
A `SpinButton` allows the user to select a value from a
range of numeric values. It has an `Entry` widget with increment and decrement buttons
at the side. Clicking the buttons causes the value to 'spin' up and down across
the range of possible values. The `Entry` widget may also
be used to enter a value directly.
blocks.zh: SpinButton允许用户从一个数值范围内选择一个值。它包含了一个Entry部件在其侧边有递增和递减按钮。单击按钮会使得值在可能的范围内“旋转”。你也可以直接在Entry部件中输入一个值。

blocks.text:
The value can have an adjustable number of decimal places, and the step size is
configurable. `SpinButton`s have an 'auto-repeat' feature
as well: holding down the increment or decrement button can optionally cause the value to
change more quickly the longer the button is held down.
blocks.zh: 这个值的小数位可以进行调整，步长也可以进行配置。SpinButton具有“自动重复”功能：长按递增、递减按钮该值的变化速度会越来越快。

blocks.text:
`SpinButton`s use an Adjustment object to hold information about
the range of values. These Adjustment attributes are used by the Spin Button
like so:




 `value`: value for the Spin Button





 `lower`: lower range value





 `upper`: upper range value




 `step_increment`: value to increment/decrement when pressing
mouse button 1





 `page_increment`: value to increment/decrement when pressing
mouse button 2





 `page_size`: unused
value: value for the Spin Button
lower: lower range value
blocks.zh: lower：微调按钮允许的最小值

blocks.text: upper: upper range value
blocks.zh: upper：微调按钮允许的最大值

blocks.text: step_increment: value to increment/decrement when pressing mouse button 1
blocks.zh: step_increment：鼠标键1(通常是左键)点击一下递增/递减的值

blocks.text: page_increment: value to increment/decrement when pressing mouse button 2
blocks.zh: page_increment：鼠标键2(通常是右键)点击一下递增/递减的值

blocks.text: page_size: unused

Additionally, mouse button 3 can be used to jump directly to the
`upper` or `lower` values.
blocks.zh: 另外，鼠标键3(通常是中键)用于直接跳到upper或lower values。

blocks.text:
The `SpinButton` can create a default
`Adjustment`, which you can access via the
get_adjustment() method, or you can specify an existing
`Adjustment` in the constructor.
blocks.zh: SpinButton可以创建一个默认状态的Adjustment，然后你可以调用get_adjustment()方法访问这个Adjustment，也可以通过SpinButton的构造函数直接使用一个已经存在的Adjustment。

blocks.text: Methods

The number of decimal places can be altered using the
set_digits() method.
blocks.zh: 数值的小数位可以使用set_digits()方法进行调整。

blocks.text:
You can set the spinbutton's value using the set_value()
method, and retrieve it with get_value().
blocks.zh: 你可以使用set_value()方法设置微调按钮的值，也可以使用get_value()方法获得微调按钮的值。

blocks.text:
The spin() method 'spins' the
`SpinButton`, as if its increment or decrement button had been clicked.
You need to specify a `Gtk::SpinType` to specify the
direction or new position.
blocks.zh: spin()方法的行为和手动点击递增/递减按钮一样。你需要传递一个Gtk::SpinType对象给该方法以指定是递增还是递减。

blocks.text:
To prevent the user from typing non-numeric characters into the entry box, pass
`true` to the set_numeric() method.
blocks.zh: 将true传递给set_numeric()方法可以阻止用户在条目框内输入非数字字符。

blocks.text:
To make the `SpinButton` 'wrap' between its upper and
lower bounds, use the set_wrap() method.
blocks.zh: 使用set_wrap()方法指定SpinButton的值到达上下限的时候是否绕回。

blocks.text:
To force it to snap to the nearest `step_increment`,
use set_snap_to_ticks().
blocks.zh: 使用set_snap_to_ticks()方法可以在向微调按钮设置了无效值的时候强制校正到最接近step_increment策略可达到的有效值。
